description.en-US:
A map for cycling, hiking and public transport in Switzerland, in the spirit of the old
GPS boxes: one screen, big buttons, the official hiking trails, cycling routes and
public-transport lines in their signpost colours on the swisstopo map. Routing runs on
the phone (BRouter, OpenStreetMap data), through as many stops as you like, with
turn-by-turn guidance that goes on with the screen off, an elevation profile and the
time of arrival; a GPX track can be followed as it is. Public transport: the next
journeys to your stop, drawn leg by leg, then guidance in big letters (walk, board, get
off, change) with real-time timetables online and an optional offline timetable of all
Switzerland. Favourites, people and firms from the search.ch directory with your own
key, a night map, and the whole country saved offline in one button. A route planner on
every map (start, destination, date and time, share, keep, GO). Six languages. No
account, no tracking: the network serves the map tiles, the downloads and searches you
ask for, and the transit map sends your position to transport.opendata.ch to find the
stops around you.
